name: Raze's species
description: This alien race were immense and had pale skin. They were distinguished by their long limbs and tall, wattled necks. Their heads were dominated by a pair of heavy tusks that protected their mouths and necks, and their long arms gave them an incredible reach. Raze was a member of this species.

data.name: Raze's species
data.distinctions: Heavy tusks, long arms, tall wattled necks
